FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Inspection Coordinator, Phone: (555) 123-4567, Email: john.smith@athletesedgestore.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Athlete's Edge Sporting Goods is a retail establishment specializing in a wide range of sporting goods, including apparel, footwear, and equipment for various sports such as running, tennis, and fitness training. Our core operations are focused on providing high-quality products to meet the needs of recreational and competitive athletes. We are committed to maintaining a safe shopping environment and adhering to all local, state, and federal regulations regarding product safety and customer service. Our knowledgeable staff is trained to assist customers with product selection and ensure the correct usage of equipment. We do not engage in the sale, rental, or repair of firearms or ammunition, as we prioritize a low-severity liability profile in our operations. Additionally, we have implemented customer safety measures, including clear signage and instructions for the proper use of equipment, to further reduce the risk of injury.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any activities involving gun or ammunition sales that exceed 5% of annual receipts and confirms that we do not conduct any repair or rental of firearms or ammunition. Additionally, we do not sell or rent motorized sporting equipment, and all instructional activities are conducted exclusively by certified staff with documented safety protocols in place.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses related to inventory theft were reported on August 15, 2023, amounting to $2,500. This incident is currently under investigation, with security footage being reviewed to identify the culprits. Steps have been taken to enhance security measures in the store to prevent future occurrences.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Mon-Sat 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM; Sun 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: TL-30 Safe, Class B, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel and surveillance systems in place to enhance store safety and deter theft.
